description: Meta FNCER: Incorporar en la matriz energética nueva capacidad instalada a partir de Fuentes No Convencionales de Energía Renovable - FNCER is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Ministerio de Minas y Energía - MinEnergía, Bogotá D.C.. Comprende los reportes de la capacidad instalada a partir de FNCER instaladas o en pruebas en la matriz de generación. Se tienen en cuenta en cada corte los proyectos reportados directamente por los agentes, proyectos registrados en PARATEC ( ) y pequeños proyectos reportados por los OR. Las metas son medidas en distintos horizontes. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Minas y Energía - MinEnergía, Bogotá D.C.. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2022-10-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
